notices.title: Not connected
notices.reason: The DSPi is not connected, or it went away.
notices.action: Connect the DSPi and try again.

notices.title: Transfer failed
notices.reason: The DSPi did not answer as expected.
notices.action: Try again. If it keeps failing, reconnect the DSPi.

notices.title: Change refused
notices.reason: The DSPi refused the request.
notices.action: Check the value and try again.

notices.title: Not a valid value
notices.reason: A value was out of range or not understood.
notices.action: Check the value and try again.

notices.title: Not available
notices.reason: The connected firmware does not have this feature.
notices.action: Update the DSPi's firmware to use it.

notices.title: Read-only
notices.reason: This firmware's settings can be shown but not changed in this version.
notices.action: Update the app or the DSPi's firmware to make changes.

notices.title: Read-only mode
notices.reason: This console is in read-only mode: the DSPi's settings are shown but nothing is sent to it.
notices.action: Turn read-only mode off to make changes.

notices.title: A safe apply is waiting
notices.reason: Read-only mode cannot start while a safe apply waits for Keep or Revert: its way back would be refused.
notices.action: Keep or revert the change, then turn read-only mode on.

notices.title: Another console is applying changes
notices.reason: The hub lets one console change the DSPi at a time.
notices.action: Wait a moment and try again.

notices.title: Not allowed
notices.reason: This console's role on the hub does not allow that change.
notices.action: Ask an Admin of the hub for the Control role.

notices.title: DSPi Link failed
notices.reason: The connection to the hub failed.
notices.action: Check the hub and the network, then connect again.

notices.title: Wrong PIN
notices.reason: The hub did not accept the PIN.
notices.action: Check the PIN the hub shows and enter it again.

notices.title: Too many attempts
notices.reason: The hub refuses new attempts for a while.
notices.action: Wait a minute, then try again.

notices.title: Hub busy
notices.reason: The hub has no free session.
notices.action: Close another console's connection, or try again later.

notices.title: A different hub
notices.reason: The hub at this address is not the one paired before.
notices.action: Pair with this hub again if it replaced the old one.

notices.title: The hub refused the connection
notices.reason: The hub did not let this console in.
notices.action: Check the hub's settings, then connect again.

notices.title: The hub did not answer
notices.reason: No answer came from the hub in time.
notices.action: Check the network, then connect again.

notices.title: Connection closed
notices.reason: The hub closed the connection.
notices.action: Connect again to continue.

notices.title: Still reading the DSPi
notices.reason: The DSPi's settings are still being read.
notices.action: Try again in a moment.

notices.title: unsecured
notices.reason: The connection to this hub is not encrypted.
notices.action: Fine on a trusted local network or over a VPN; see the details for more.

notices.title: Unencrypted connection
notices.reason: The connection to this hub is not encrypted. That is fine on a trusted local network or over a VPN, but on any other network someone could read or change what is sent, including the pairing PIN and settings.
notices.action: If the hub supports encryption, turn TLS on in its settings, or turn its upstream compatibility mode off; this console then connects encrypted by itself.

notices.title: File not read or written
notices.reason: A file could not be read or written.
notices.action: Check the file and its folder, then try again.

notices.title: AutoEQ update failed
notices.reason: The headphone database could not be updated.
notices.action: Try again later.

notices.title: AutoEQ update paused
notices.reason: The server asked to wait before the next update.
notices.action: Try again later.

notices.title: AutoEQ update failed
notices.reason: The server could not be reached.
notices.action: Check the network connection, then try again.

notices.title: Firmware not installed
notices.reason: This firmware image can leave the DSPi's core voltage too low. Nothing was written.
notices.action: Choose a different firmware image.

notices.title: Not a verified DSPi Console image
notices.reason: This file is not one of the firmware images that come with DSPi Console, so it could not be checked against them.
notices.action: Flash it only if you know where it came from, such as your own build. The usual checks still apply.

notices.title: Confirmation needed
notices.reason: This raises the core voltage above 1.20 V. Nothing was written.
notices.action: Type OVERVOLT to confirm, or keep the current voltage.

notices.title: Not confirmed
notices.reason: This change needs a confirmation, and it was missing, was for another change, or had run out. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Confirm the change again.

notices.title: Outside the limits
notices.reason: The installer's limits profile for this DSPi does not allow that value. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Choose a value within the limits, or ask the installer to change them.

notices.title: Limits profile unreadable
notices.reason: The limits profile for this DSPi could not be read, so the last good copy of it is in force.
notices.action: Ask the installer to check the limits profile and save it again.

notices.title: Limits profile unreadable
notices.reason: The limits profile for this DSPi could not be read and there is no good copy of it, so no limits are in force.
notices.action: Ask the installer to set the limits profile again.

notices.title: Limits apply here only
notices.reason: The DSPi itself does not know these limits: a control surface, the UART or a console without this profile can still go past them.
notices.action: Set the same profile on every console that controls this DSPi.

notices.title: Locked by the installer
notices.reason: The installer has locked this DSPi on this console: only volume, mute and presets can be changed. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Ask the installer, or unlock with the installer's PIN.

notices.title: Locked by the installer
notices.reason: The installer has locked this DSPi on this console: only volume, mute and presets can be changed. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Ask the installer, or unlock with the installer's PIN.

notices.title: Installer PIN needed
notices.reason: An installer PIN is set for this DSPi on this console, so this needs the Installer unlock. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Unlock with the installer's PIN, then try again.

notices.title: Wrong PIN
notices.reason: That is not the installer's PIN or recovery code for this DSPi.
notices.action: Check the PIN and enter it again.

notices.title: Too many wrong PINs
notices.reason: After several wrong PINs, new attempts are refused for a while.
notices.action: Wait until the time shown, then try again.

notices.title: No installer PIN set
notices.reason: No installer PIN is set for this DSPi on this console, so there is nothing to lock.
notices.action: Set an installer PIN in the Installer mode first.

notices.title: This lock is on this console
notices.reason: This lock is on this console; the DSPi itself is open. It is a lock for everyday use, not a security boundary: another console or tool can still change the DSPi.
notices.action: For real access control, connect the DSPi through a hub and use its roles.

notices.title: Keep the recovery code
notices.reason: The recovery code unlocks this DSPi on this console if the PIN is forgotten. It is shown only now.
notices.action: Write it in the hand-over note and keep it away from the system's users.

notices.title: Only an Admin may write this
notices.reason: This DSPi has a limits profile or an installer lock on its hub, so the hub lets only an Admin write its whole state at once. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Change single settings instead, or connect to the hub as an Admin.

notices.title: Limits could not be checked
notices.reason: The hub could not read this DSPi's state to check the change against its limits profile. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Try again in a moment.

notices.title: Locked on the hub
notices.reason: The hub this DSPi is connected through holds its installer lock, so the hub's PIN unlocks it for this console.
notices.action: Enter the installer's PIN for this DSPi on the hub.

notices.title: Locked by the installer
notices.reason: Locked by the installer: only volume, mute and presets can be changed.
notices.action: Unlock with the installer's PIN to change more.

notices.title: Editing the hub's copy
notices.reason: This DSPi is reached through a hub, so these limits, the installer PIN and the pinned modes are the hub's: they hold for every console on the hub.
notices.action: Changes apply on the hub at once. Connect the DSPi directly to edit this console's own copy.

notices.title: Editing this console's copy
notices.reason: This DSPi is connected directly, so these limits and the installer PIN are this console's own copy.
notices.action: When the DSPi is reached through a hub, the hub's copy is the one in force and edited.

notices.title: Read-only: Admin needed
notices.reason: Only an Admin of the hub may change its limits, installer PIN and pinned modes. A console paired with the hub's PIN is a Control client.
notices.action: On the hub's machine, find this console with uconsole hub clients and run uconsole hub role <cid> admin (hub stopped), or type role <cid> admin at the running hub's prompt, where it applies at once.

notices.title: Read-only: Admin needed
notices.reason: Only an Admin of the hub may change its alarm rules, schedules, notifications, MQTT settings and API keys. A console paired with the hub's PIN is a Control client.
notices.action: On the hub's machine, find this console with uconsole hub clients and run uconsole hub role <cid> admin (hub stopped), or type role <cid> admin at the running hub's prompt, where it applies at once.

notices.title: Not on the hub
notices.reason: The hub does not know this DSPi, snapshot or record (it may have been forgotten or deleted).
notices.action: Refresh the list and choose again.

notices.title: The DSPi is not attached
notices.reason: The hub knows this DSPi, but it is not attached now. Nothing was sent, and nothing is kept for later.
notices.action: Attach the DSPi to the hub and try again.

notices.title: The hub's copy differs
notices.reason: The hub refused this because its own state disagrees: it holds a different copy, a store is full, a document is too large, or another change is waiting.
notices.action: Refresh, then keep the hub's copy or save this one under a new name.

notices.title: Hub busy
notices.reason: The hub is handling as many requests as it takes at once.
notices.action: Try again in a moment.

notices.title: The DSPi refused
notices.reason: The hub sent the command, and the DSPi refused it.
notices.action: Check the value and the DSPi's state, then try again.

notices.title: This hub keeps no limits
notices.reason: The hub this DSPi is reached through does not keep limits profiles or installer PINs, so there is nothing to edit here.
notices.action: Update the hub, or connect the DSPi directly to edit this console's copy.

notices.title: Compatibility mode is on
notices.reason: This hub runs in upstream compatibility mode, so it also takes unencrypted connections, for DSPi Link clients that cannot encrypt.
notices.action: When no such client needs it any more, start the hub without --upstream-compat, and connect again.

notices.title: Security downgraded: upstream compatibility mode is on
notices.reason: This hub also takes unencrypted DSPi Link connections, so upstream clients can connect. On those connections nothing is encrypted: anyone on this network can read the traffic, including PINs, tokens and API keys, and change it in transit. The hub's key is not pinned on them, so a client cannot tell this hub from another machine posing as it. Pairing with a PIN is allowed without encryption, so a listener can take the token a new client is given. Every REST API key works without encryption, not only keys minted for it. The hub does not advertise that it requires encryption.
notices.action: Use it only on a network you trust, and only while you need it. To turn it off, start the hub on its machine without --upstream-compat.

notices.title: Keep the recovery code
notices.reason: The recovery code unlocks this DSPi on the hub if the PIN is forgotten; an Admin of the hub can also clear the PIN. It is shown only now.
notices.action: Write it in the hand-over note and keep it away from the system's users.

notices.title: Configuration not read
notices.reason: The file is not a DSPi configuration this version reads. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Choose another file, or update the app if the file came from a newer version.

notices.title: Nothing selected
notices.reason: No part of the configuration was chosen to apply. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Choose at least one part to apply.

notices.title: Still reading the DSPi
notices.reason: The DSPi's settings have not been read yet.
notices.action: Try again in a moment.

notices.title: Keep these settings?
notices.reason: They go back in {s} s unless you press Keep.
notices.action: Press Keep to keep them, or Revert to go back now.

notices.title: The hub keeps the way back too
notices.reason: The hub puts them back too if this console goes away.
notices.action: Press Keep or Revert here as usual.

notices.title: DSPi not attached
notices.reason: The hub has not seen this DSPi since {time}.
notices.action: Check its cable and its power.

notices.title: DSPi not answering
notices.reason: The DSPi is attached to the hub but has not answered since {time}.
notices.action: Check its power, or unplug it and plug it in again.

notices.title: Restarted at {time} ({reason})
notices.reason: The DSPi started again by itself.
notices.action: If it happens again, check its power supply and save a diagnostics bundle.

notices.title: Clipping
notices.reason: The signal reached full scale on the DSPi.
notices.action: Lower the input level or the gain.

notices.title: Running hot
notices.reason: The DSPi's temperature reached the alarm's threshold.
notices.action: Give it more air, or lower the load.

notices.title: Processing load high
notices.reason: The DSPi's processing load stayed at or above the alarm's threshold.
notices.action: Use fewer filters or channels.

notices.title: A schedule did not complete
notices.reason: Some actions of a schedule failed at {time}.
notices.action: Look at the schedule's last run to see which, then run it again if needed.

notices.title: The hub's clock is not set
notices.reason: Schedules wait until the hub's clock reads the right time.
notices.action: Set the hub's clock, or let it set itself from the network.

notices.title: Audio link lost
notices.reason: A unit is not locked to the audio link.
notices.action: Check the audio link cable to that unit.

notices.title: Unit not attached
notices.reason: A unit of the audio link system is not attached to the hub.
notices.action: Attach it again, or take it out of the system.

notices.title: Audio link errors
notices.reason: The audio link is receiving damaged frames.
notices.action: Check the audio link cables and connectors.

notices.title: Audio link caught up
notices.reason: A unit's audio had a short silence while the link caught up.
notices.action: Nothing to do unless it happens again.

notices.title: System muted
notices.reason: The audio link system's mute is on.
notices.action: Unmute the system to hear it.

notices.title: Delay too short
notices.reason: A unit's audio link delay is below what it needs to stay in step.
notices.action: Raise the system's delay.

notices.title: USB-direct unit cannot lock
notices.reason: A USB-direct unit cannot stay in step with the audio link.
notices.action: Check its USB connection and the system's delay.

notices.title: Re-align failed
notices.reason: The hub could not write a USB-direct unit's output delays.
notices.action: Check that the unit is attached, then align the system again.

notices.title: Setting put back
notices.reason: The hub put a USB-direct unit's lock-error action back to the system's.
notices.action: Nothing to do.

notices.title: USB-direct units re-aligned
notices.reason: The hub wrote the USB-direct units' output delays again to keep them aligned.
notices.action: Nothing to do.

notices.title: Firmware update failed
notices.reason: The hub could not finish updating this DSPi's firmware.
notices.action: Look at the update's record on the hub to see where it stopped, then start it again if needed.

notices.title: Encrypted connection needed
notices.reason: The hub takes this only over an encrypted connection.
notices.action: Connect to the hub with encryption on, then try again.

notices.title: Encrypted connection needed
notices.reason: This hub was paired with encryption before, so this console connects to it only encrypted, and it refused encryption. Nothing was sent, not even the PIN.
notices.action: Turn TLS on in the hub's settings, then connect again. To use it without encryption, forget the hub first, then pair again.

notices.title: Checking the DSPi and the image
notices.reason: The hub checks that the DSPi is on its own USB, answering, muted and free, and that the image suits it.
notices.action: If it stops here, do what the hub says: mute the DSPi, wait for its lock, or choose a verified image for its platform.

notices.title: Checking the core voltage
notices.reason: The hub reads the board's core voltage and asks the firmware guard whether the image suits it, with nobody to confirm.
notices.action: If it stops here, the image does not suit this board: choose an image made for its core voltage.

notices.title: Saving the settings
notices.reason: The hub saves the DSPi's settings in its snapshot store before anything changes.
notices.action: If it stops here, make room in the hub's snapshot store and start again.

notices.title: Restarting into the bootloader
notices.reason: The hub sends the DSPi to its bootloader. From here on the update cannot be cancelled.
notices.action: If it stops here, check the DSPi's lock and installer lock, then start again.

notices.title: Finding the board
notices.reason: The hub waits for exactly one board in its bootloader on its own USB.
notices.action: If it stops here, the DSPi may still be in its bootloader: unplug any other board in its bootloader and start again.

notices.title: Writing the firmware
notices.reason: The hub writes the image, reads it back and compares it, then restarts the board.
notices.action: If it stops here, the board may be left in its bootloader: start the update again.

notices.title: Waiting for the DSPi
notices.reason: The hub waits up to 60 s for the DSPi to come back with its new firmware.
notices.action: If it does not come back, check its cable and its power.

notices.title: Checking the new firmware
notices.reason: The hub checks the firmware version, the extensions and the core voltage, and compares the settings with the saved ones.
notices.action: If the settings changed, recall the saved settings from the hub's snapshot store.

notices.title: Firmware update step
notices.reason: The hub reported a step this version does not know.
notices.action: Read the hub's own words, or update the app.

notices.title: Hub alarm
notices.reason: The hub raised an alarm this version does not know.
notices.action: Read the alarm's own words, or update the app.

notices.title: No signal generator
notices.reason: This firmware has no signal generator, which a measurement plays. Only the microphone's spectrum of what is playing is available.
notices.action: Update the DSPi's firmware (v1.1.5 or later) to measure.

notices.title: Measuring needs Control
notices.reason: A Viewer on the hub may not play the signal generator.
notices.action: Ask the hub's admin for the Control role.

notices.title: Measuring is locked
notices.reason: The installer has locked measuring on this DSPi.
notices.action: Ask the installer to unlock it.

notices.title: A safe apply is waiting
notices.reason: A change is waiting for Keep or Revert.
notices.action: Keep or revert it, then measure.

notices.title: An A/B compare is running
notices.reason: A measurement cannot start during an A/B compare.
notices.action: End the compare, then measure.

notices.title: Volume too high to measure
notices.reason: A measurement starts only with the volume at -12 dB or below.
notices.action: Lower the volume, then measure. The measurement sets its own level.

notices.title: Master volume above its limit
notices.reason: The master volume is above what the limits profile allows.
notices.action: Lower the master volume, then measure.

notices.title: Something is playing
notices.reason: An input carries audio, and a measurement needs silence.
notices.action: Stop playback, then measure.

notices.title: Sample rate not supported
notices.reason: The DSPi runs at a rate the measurement does not model.
notices.action: Run the DSPi at 44.1, 48 or 96 kHz to measure.

notices.title: Measurement too long
notices.reason: A run would be longer than 120 s or hold more than the capture's bound.
notices.action: Measure fewer outputs in a run, use shorter sweeps, or capture at 48 kHz.

notices.title: No such output
notices.reason: The setup names an output this DSPi does not have.
notices.action: Choose the DSPi's own outputs.

notices.title: Output switched off
notices.reason: An output to measure is switched off.
notices.action: Switch it on, then measure.

notices.title: Output muted
notices.reason: An output to measure is muted.
notices.action: Unmute it, then measure.

notices.title: No protective high-pass
notices.reason: A middle or high way is measured only through an active high-pass, so its driver is never driven below its range.
notices.action: Set the way's crossover high-pass (at least 12 dB per octave, at 1 kHz or above for a high way, 80 Hz or above for a middle way), then measure.

notices.title: Crossfeed is on
notices.reason: Crossfeed changes what an output plays, and the measurement does not model it.
notices.action: Switch crossfeed off for these outputs, then measure.

notices.title: Psychoacoustic bass is on
notices.reason: Psychoacoustic bass changes what an output plays, and the measurement does not model it.
notices.action: Switch it off for these outputs, then measure.

notices.title: Tube preamp is on
notices.reason: The tube preamp changes what an output plays, and the measurement does not model it.
notices.action: Switch it off for these outputs, then measure.

notices.title: Subharmonic synthesizer is on
notices.reason: The subharmonic synthesizer changes what an output plays, and the measurement does not model it.
notices.action: Switch it off for these outputs, then measure.

notices.title: Loudness is on
notices.reason: Loudness changes what an output plays with the volume, and the measurement does not model it.
notices.action: Switch loudness off for these outputs, then measure.

notices.title: Limiter would act
notices.reason: An output's limiter acts at or below the measurement's level.
notices.action: Switch the limiter off, or raise its threshold above the measurement's ceiling, then measure.

notices.title: Settings changed since the measurement
notices.reason: An output's settings are no longer the ones it was measured with.
notices.action: Measure again, or check what changed.

notices.title: Input EQ is not part of the measurement
notices.reason: An input has EQ. What the generator plays does not pass through it.
notices.action: Nothing to do; it still shapes what is played.

notices.title: Measure on the coupler
notices.reason: Headphones are measured on the coupler, not on a head.
notices.action: Seat the headphones on the coupler.

notices.title: No microphone calibration
notices.reason: Without a calibration, levels are relative and there is no sound level cap.
notices.action: Import the microphone's calibration file for calibrated levels.

notices.title: Volume muted
notices.reason: The volume is muted: the microphone will hear nothing.
notices.action: Unmute the volume before measuring.

notices.title: The microphone does not follow
notices.reason: The level was raised but the microphone's level did not rise with it, so the level stopped there.
notices.action: Check the microphone and the wiring to this output, then measure again.

notices.title: The microphone does not hear this output
notices.reason: The output was played louder step by step, and the microphone did not hear it.
notices.action: Check the microphone, its input and the wiring to this output, then measure again.

notices.title: Too quiet to hear at the start level
notices.reason: The output was played at the start level only, and the microphone did not hear it there, so the measurement did not start.
notices.action: Measure with the level ramp, or check the microphone, its input and the wiring to this output.

notices.title: Measurement stopped
notices.reason: The measurement was stopped. Nothing was kept.
notices.action: Start again when ready.

notices.title: Not enough signal
notices.reason: The measurement could not find the signal in the microphone's capture.
notices.action: Check the microphone's placement and level, then measure again.

notices.title: Stopped: the volume changed
notices.reason: The volume changed during the measurement. Nothing was kept.
notices.action: Leave the volume alone while measuring, then measure again.

notices.title: Stopped: a setting changed
notices.reason: Another console or the DSPi itself changed a setting during the measurement. Nothing was kept.
notices.action: Measure again when nothing else is changing the DSPi.

notices.title: Stopped: a preset was loaded
notices.reason: A preset was loaded during the measurement. Nothing was kept.
notices.action: Measure again.

notices.title: Stopped: the input format changed
notices.reason: The input's rate or channels changed during the measurement. Nothing was kept.
notices.action: Measure again when the input is steady.

notices.title: Stopped: an input stream changed
notices.reason: An input stream started or stopped during the measurement. Nothing was kept.
notices.action: Stop playback, then measure again.

notices.title: Stopped: the DSPi clipped
notices.reason: The DSPi reported a clip during the measurement. Nothing was kept.
notices.action: Measure again; lower the ceiling if it happens again.

notices.title: Stopped: the generator was taken over
notices.reason: Another console or a preset load started or stopped the signal generator. Nothing was kept.
notices.action: Measure again when no other console uses the generator.

notices.title: Stopped: the microphone's rate
notices.reason: The microphone runs at another rate than the measurement was set up for. Nothing was kept.
notices.action: Set the measurement's capture rate to the microphone's, then measure again.

notices.title: Stopped: the microphone's capture skipped
notices.reason: Part of the microphone's capture was lost or repeated. Nothing was kept.
notices.action: Close other programs using audio, then measure again.

notices.title: Stopped: the microphone clipped
notices.reason: The microphone's capture reached full scale. Nothing was kept.
notices.action: Lower the microphone's input gain, then measure again.

notices.title: Stopped: too loud
notices.reason: The sound level reached the measurement's cap. Nothing was kept.
notices.action: Measure again; the level ramp starts quiet.

notices.title: Stopped: the device lock was lost
notices.reason: The measurement's hold on the DSPi ended. Nothing was kept.
notices.action: Measure again.

notices.title: Stopped: the run took too long
notices.reason: The run took longer than planned. Nothing was kept.
notices.action: Check the connection to the DSPi, then measure again.

notices.title: Stopped: the DSPi did not answer
notices.reason: The DSPi stopped answering during the measurement. Nothing was kept.
notices.action: Reconnect the DSPi, then measure again.

notices.title: Stopped: the capture does not line up
notices.reason: The microphone's capture does not match what the generator played. Nothing was kept.
notices.action: Measure again; if it keeps happening, try another microphone input.

notices.title: Stopped: something started playing
notices.reason: Audio appeared on an input during the measurement. Nothing was kept.
notices.action: Stop playback, then measure again.

notices.title: Stopped: an output reached full scale
notices.reason: A measured output reached full scale. Nothing was kept.
notices.action: Measure again with a lower ceiling.

notices.title: Stopped: a limiter acted
notices.reason: A measured output's limiter acted during the measurement. Nothing was kept.
notices.action: Raise the limiter's threshold or switch it off, then measure again.

notices.title: No measured curve yet
notices.reason: The live view has not finished its first sweep, so there is nothing to adjust from.
notices.action: Wait for the first curve, then try again.

notices.title: Nothing to change there
notices.reason: The curve already follows the target there within the bounds, the measurement is not trusted there, or no PEQ band is free.
notices.action: Pick another point or range, or free a PEQ band of this output.

notices.title: The EQ changed since the preview
notices.reason: This output's EQ was changed after the change was previewed, so it was not written.
notices.action: Preview the change again.

notices.title: No timing changes from this measurement
notices.reason: The measurement did not pass the timing check, so its delays and phases cannot be trusted. Only the EQ is proposed.
notices.action: Measure again with the microphone still and nothing else playing to tune delay, polarity and the crossover.

notices.title: The summed check did not confirm the timing
notices.reason: The two ways played together did not sound as the measurement predicted, so the delay, polarity and crossover changes were withdrawn. The EQ stays.
notices.action: Check that the microphone did not move, then measure again.

notices.title: No timing changes for this speaker
notices.reason: The measurement has no usable phase or arrival for every way, or no alignment was found within the limits.
notices.action: Measure the speaker's ways together at the listening position.

notices.title: A change would pass a limit
notices.reason: A proposed change would be refused by the limits or the device's ranges, so that kind of change was withdrawn for this speaker.
notices.action: Review the limits profile, or tune this speaker by hand.

notices.title: No EQ fit for this speaker
notices.reason: The EQ fit was withdrawn: a band it needed would pass a limit.
notices.action: Free a PEQ band or review the limits profile.

notices.title: Measurement of another DSPi
notices.reason: The measurement was made on another DSPi, so its proposal cannot be applied here.
notices.action: Open the DSPi it was made on, or measure this one.

notices.title: An old measurement
notices.reason: The measurement is more than 30 days old.
notices.action: Measure again if the room or the speakers changed.

notices.title: Another placement
notices.reason: The measurement was made with the microphone placed otherwise than the tune expects, or an output was measured as another way.
notices.action: Check the result, or measure at the listening position.

notices.title: Settings changed since the measurement
notices.reason: An output's settings changed after it was measured. The proposal is predicted against the settings now.
notices.action: Measure again if the speaker or the room changed.

notices.title: Run the summed check first
notices.reason: Delay, polarity and crossover changes are applied only after the summed check confirmed the measurement's timing.
notices.action: Run the summed check, then apply.

notices.title: The measurement's microphone is needed
notices.reason: The summed and verifying runs must use the calibration the measurement was made with, and it is not at hand.
notices.action: Import the microphone's calibration, or give its document.

notices.title: The tune was not applied
notices.reason: A change was refused while the tune was applied, or a snapshot could not be filed. The settings from before were put back where needed.
notices.action: Read the message, then propose the tune again.

notices.title: The verify did not confirm the tune
notices.reason: The measurement after applying the tune did not agree with its prediction, so the tune may not do what it promised.
notices.action: Revert it, or confirm Keep a second time to keep it anyway.

notices.title: The verify may outlast the guard
notices.reason: Verifying this tune takes longer than the guard's longest wait (590 s), so the guard may put the settings from before back while the verify still runs.
notices.action: Measure again with shorter sweeps or fewer repeats, or decide Keep or Revert before the guard ends.

notices.title: Measuring several units needs the DSPi hub
notices.reason: Measuring several units together needs the DSPi hub: it starts every unit's generator on one shared sample counter. This console is not connected through such a hub.
notices.action: Connect through the DSPi hub, or measure one unit at a time.

notices.title: A unit was not checked
notices.reason: Each unit is checked on its own connection before a system measurement (volume, tweeter protection, silent inputs, processing).
notices.action: Open every unit of the group and check it again.

notices.title: The units run at different rates
notices.reason: One time base has one sample rate: every unit of the group must run at the same rate.
notices.action: Set the units to one sample rate, then measure again.

notices.title: These units do not share a clock
notices.reason: The units are not on one time base (one sender, one USB controller, or one S/PDIF source).
notices.action: Measure units that share one time base together, or measure them one at a time.

notices.title: A unit's time base is not locked
notices.reason: A unit has not locked to the shared time base, so its generator cannot start on its sample.
notices.action: Wait until every unit shows locked, then measure again.

notices.title: A unit cannot start on the time base
notices.reason: The unit's firmware cannot start its generator at a sample of the shared counter.
notices.action: Update the unit's firmware, or measure it on its own.

notices.title: The hub did not schedule the run
notices.reason: The hub refused to place the measurement's starts on the time base.
notices.action: Read the message, then try again.

notices.title: The group does not fit a measurement
notices.reason: The outputs or the sweep do not fit the measurement's limits.
notices.action: Shorten the sweep or measure fewer outputs.

notices.title: A unit clipped
notices.reason: An output of the named unit clipped during the measurement. It was stopped.
notices.action: Lower that unit's level or check its outputs, then measure again.

notices.title: An output reached full scale
notices.reason: An output of the named unit reached full scale. The measurement was stopped.
notices.action: Check that output's gain and measure again.

notices.title: A limiter acted
notices.reason: A limiter of the named unit acted during the measurement, so the response would be wrong. It was stopped.
notices.action: Lower the level or the limiter's threshold, then measure again.

notices.title: Unit lost lock
notices.reason: The named unit's time base was disturbed during the run (a re-anchor, a correction or a holdover). Nothing was kept.
notices.action: Wait until the unit is locked and steady, then measure again.

notices.title: Unit lost lock
notices.reason: The named unit's time base changed during the run. Nothing was kept.
notices.action: Check the unit's link or cable, then measure again.

notices.title: A unit's generator did not play
notices.reason: The named unit refused, cancelled or did not prove one of its starts. Nothing was kept.
notices.action: Read the message, then measure again.

notices.title: The hub stopped the measurement
notices.reason: The hub stopped every unit on its own: a write by someone else, a preset load, a lost unit or a missed status.
notices.action: Read the message, then measure again.

notices.title: The hub does not answer
notices.reason: The connection to the hub was lost during the measurement. The hub stops every unit by itself.
notices.action: Reconnect, then measure again.

notices.title: The run took too long
notices.reason: The measurement ran past its planned end or its capture limit. It was stopped.
notices.action: Measure again.

notices.title: The run was discarded
notices.reason: A unit did not prove that it played exactly as scheduled, or its time base moved. Nothing is proposed from this run.
notices.action: Read the message naming the unit, then measure again.

notices.title: Timing unreliable
notices.reason: The delay between the units could not be measured within 10 microseconds: the capture clock wandered between their sweeps. Nothing is proposed for them.
notices.action: Measure again with a steadier microphone interface, or with more passes.

notices.title: The runs do not chain
notices.reason: The anchor output measured differently between runs: the microphone or the room changed.
notices.action: Keep the microphone still and measure the group again.

notices.title: The summed check failed
notices.reason: The units played together did not sum as the measurement predicted, so its delays across units are not trusted. Every cross-unit delay is withdrawn.
notices.action: Measure again; check that nothing moved.

notices.title: Run the summed check
notices.reason: Before delays across units can be applied, each transition between them is measured played together.
notices.action: Run the summed check.

notices.title: Applying needs Admin
notices.reason: Applying an alignment across units writes the hub's installation, which needs the Admin role.
notices.action: Ask an Admin to apply it, or save the measurement.

notices.title: Nothing to apply
notices.reason: No delay across the units could be offered from this measurement.
notices.action: Read the reasons, then measure again.

notices.title: The verify did not confirm the alignment
notices.reason: The summed runs after applying did not agree with the prediction.
notices.action: Revert it, or keep it if the result sounds right.

notices.title: Microphone not available here
notices.reason: Browsers offer the microphone only to a secure page: one served over https or from this machine's own address.
notices.action: Open the console through the hub's https address or the local web console.

notices.title: Microphone not available
notices.reason: This browser cannot capture the microphone the way a measurement needs.
notices.action: Use a current Chromium-based browser or Firefox.

notices.title: Microphone access denied
notices.reason: The browser was not allowed to use the microphone.
notices.action: Allow the microphone for this page in the browser's site settings, then start again.

notices.title: Microphone not found
notices.reason: No microphone was found, or not the one chosen.
notices.action: Connect the measurement microphone, choose it again and start again.

notices.title: Microphone could not be opened
notices.reason: The microphone is in use elsewhere, or it reported an error.
notices.action: Close other programs that use it, or reconnect it, and start again.

notices.title: Microphone lost
notices.reason: The microphone went away while capturing; the capture has stopped.
notices.action: Reconnect the microphone and start again.

notices.title: Microphone capture did not start
notices.reason: The browser opened the microphone but did not start its audio processing: it may have no audio device, or it may block audio for this page.
notices.action: Allow audio for this page in the browser's site settings, check that an audio device is present, and start again.

notices.title: Newer protocol
notices.reason: This DSPi's firmware uses a newer protocol than this version knows. Nothing was sent to it after the protocol check.
notices.action: Update the app.

notices.title: Unrecognised device
notices.reason: The device answered neither as DSPi firmware 1.1.7 nor as firmware 1.1.6 or older. Nothing else was sent to it.
notices.action: Check that it is a DSPi, then reconnect it. If it keeps failing, update its firmware.

notices.title: Hub too old for this firmware
notices.reason: This DSPi does not answer the firmware 1.1.6 protocol through this hub; it probably runs firmware 1.1.7, which needs a DSPi Link 1.3 hub.
notices.action: Update the hub, or connect the DSPi directly.

notices.title: Hub serves only firmware 1.1.7
notices.reason: This hub serves only firmware 1.1.7 and later, and this DSPi runs an older firmware. Nothing was sent to it.
notices.action: Connect the DSPi directly, use a hub that serves older firmware, or update the DSPi's firmware.

notices.title: Firmware changed
notices.reason: The DSPi behind the hub now runs another firmware generation. Nothing more was sent to it on the old connection.
notices.action: Wait while it is opened again. If it does not come back, select it again.

notices.title: Something went wrong
notices.reason: The request did not complete.
notices.action: Try again.
